# powerdns_notify_zone (Action)

Sends a NOTIFY to a zone's secondaries.

PowerDNS answers `Notification queued` even for a `Native` zone with no secondaries to notify. Queued is not delivered, and this reports the former — there is no API that reports the latter.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone to act on.
